# flickpick

> Personal movie recommender: browser-first app, TypeScript core, Python build pipeline; AI agents pick movies for you


## Pages

- [flickpick](index.html.md): A personal movie recommender you can run in a browser, built so that AI agents can pick movies for y...
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;flickpick&#96;   | flickpick: a personal movie recommender (Python half: build pipeline and scorer). ...
- [flickpick](_autosummary/flickpick.html.md): flickpick: a personal movie recommender (Python half: build pipeline and scorer).
- [flickpick.artifacts](_autosummary/flickpick.artifacts.html.md): Write and read an artifact set as specified in &#96;docs/artifact-format.md&#96;.
- [flickpick.build](_autosummary/flickpick.build.html.md): The build pipeline: MovieLens tables -&gt; catalogue, sparse EASE matrix, embeddings.
- [flickpick.data](_autosummary/flickpick.data.html.md): Download (with a cache) and parse the MovieLens datasets the build uses.
- [flickpick.defaults](_autosummary/flickpick.defaults.html.md): Named defaults shared by the build pipeline, the scorer and the CLI.
- [flickpick.ease](_autosummary/flickpick.ease.html.md): EASE (Steck 2019): a closed-form linear item-item model, sparsified to top-k.
- [flickpick.embedding](_autosummary/flickpick.embedding.html.md): Sentence embeddings of catalogue text and of mood queries.
- [flickpick.importers](_autosummary/flickpick.importers.html.md): Parse ratings exports into &#96;Rating&#96; lists on the canonical 0-100 scale.
- [flickpick.ratings](_autosummary/flickpick.ratings.html.md): The canonical &#96;Rating&#96; type, and how ratings are joined to a catalogue.
- [flickpick.science](_autosummary/flickpick.science.html.md): Personal evaluation and agreement statistics (“for scientists”).
- [flickpick.score](_autosummary/flickpick.score.html.md): Score and recommend over an artifact set (&#96;docs/core-contract.md&#96;).
- [flickpick.tools](_autosummary/flickpick.tools.html.md): The command surface: plain functions returning JSON-able values (SSOT for the CLI).
- [For AI agents](ai-agents.html.md): &#96;flickpick&#96; ships artifacts for coding agents alongside its code. This page lists
